asChild.description:
Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

Use `render` when you need the part's state: `render={(props, state) => <MyButton {...props} />}`.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Pass an element to have the part's props merged into it, or a function to control the merge
yourself and read the part's state.

autoStart.description: Whether the timer should start automatically

countdown.description: Whether the timer should countdown, decrementing the timer on each tick.

ids.description: The ids of the timer parts

interval.description: The interval in milliseconds to update the timer count.

onComplete.description: Function invoked when the timer is completed

onTick.description: Function invoked when the timer ticks
